nodes.question: Does the edited image show the background changed into a basketball court?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the background as a whole is recognizably a basketball court, based on the visible scene in context. A playing surface and court markings are useful evidence, but no single feature is mandatory; basketball equipment alone does not establish a court. Fail if the background is clearly not recognizable as a basketball court. Unknown if the visual evidence does not reliably settle whether the background reads as a court.
nodes.binding: Judge completion of the requested background replacement, not merely the presence of basketball-related objects. Assess the background as a whole and weigh visible court surface, markings, equipment, and surrounding context together. Do not require any unsupported specific feature or force a conclusion at an ambiguous threshold.

nodes.question: Is there visible evidence that the background has begun changing toward a basketball court, even though completion is not established by this check?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the image shows discernible progress toward replacing the background with a basketball court, including basketball-related scene changes or partial court cues. Fail if there is no visible progress toward that requested background change. Unknown if progress cannot be distinguished from the original or assessed reliably. This is a progress judgment, not a completion judgment; a complete court background may also pass.
nodes.binding: Assess only progress toward the requested background replacement. Do not use this check to decide whether the background is complete; unrelated edits do not count as progress.

nodes.question: Replace the image background with a basketball court.
nodes.criteria: Return complete if s1 passes. Otherwise, return absent only if s1 fails and s2 fails, establishing no requested progress. Return partial if s1 fails and s2 passes, establishing incomplete progress toward the court background. Return unknown if evidence needed to distinguish these outcomes is unresolved, including when s1 is unknown and completion cannot be established. A pass on s2 does not establish completion, and unrelated edits do not count.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. You receive no reference label or optimization feedback. Return status, evidence, reported confidence (0..1 or null), and used_dependency_ids naming every supplied context check_id exactly once in saved order.
Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. A negative context observation is usable evidence. Unknown, skipped, or invalid context is not a failure and must not stop an independent image inspection. Inspect the images yourself; do not repeat a parent's answer. Return unknown when the relevant fact cannot be established. Confidence reports confidence in this answer, not calibrated correctness.
Fulfillment receives NO images. Use only saved support evidence, original instruction/rubric and frozen composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved. Never invent a visual fact or convert missing evidence into failure. A conditional skip is not non-applicability. All applicable requested outcomes complete gives yes; no requested progress gives no; known progress short of completion gives partial. Unrelated changes are not progress.
